_README: WEATHER CONFIGURATION TEMPLATE — Copy this file into a weather type folder and customize.
_type_rain: ITU-R P.838-3 via MATLAB rainpl(). Frequency-dependent path loss + volume clutter. S-band mild, X-band severe.
_type_snow: Uses rainpl() at 25% equivalent rate. Snow particles are less dense (Gunn & East, 1954). Reduced clutter.
_type_fog: Visibility-based. Mainly affects IR/optical sensors. Negligible RF below 10 GHz. Uses fogpl() (ITU-R P.840) above 10 GHz. No clutter.
_type_icing: Antenna hardware degradation. Flat Pd loss at all ranges (not a path effect). Ice on radome reduces gain 2-6 dB. No clutter.

_rain_rate_meaning_by_type.rain: Actual rain rate in mm/hr. 1-4: drizzle | 4-16: moderate | 16-50: heavy | 50+: tropical
_rain_rate_meaning_by_type.snow: Equivalent precipitation rate in mm/hr. Internally scaled to 25% for RF attenuation.
_rain_rate_meaning_by_type.fog: Fog density proxy. 5: light fog (~1km vis) | 15: moderate (~300m) | 30: dense (~100m)
_rain_rate_meaning_by_type.icing: Icing severity. 5: light rime (~2dB gain loss) | 15: moderate glaze (~4dB) | 30: severe (~6dB)

_storm_start_s: Time in seconds when weather begins. Set to 0 for weather from the start.
_storm_end_s: Time in seconds when weather clears. Must be <= scenario duration_s. Set equal to duration for weather throughout.
_active_type_step: Binary: severity = 0 outside window, 1 inside. Instant on/off.
_active_type_ramp: Linear: severity ramps from 0 to 1 over first half of window, then back to 0. Gradual onset/clearing.
_active_type_pulse: Burst: severity = 1 for first 20% of window, then 0. Sharp initial hit, quick clearing.
_pd_floor: Minimum detection probability. Even in worst conditions, Pd never drops below this. Range: 0.05 to 0.50.
_clutter_multiplier: Scales weather clutter density. 1.0 = default. 2.0 = double clutter. Only applies to rain and snow (fog/icing generate no clutter).
